scope: Wild encounter movement pauses and disconnected battle controls

diagnostics.cause: Phaser scene time in a socket callback referred to the previous frame. Held movement could be sent before the server step completed, triggering BUSY and the retained 150 ms retry delay.
diagnostics.correction: Record actual performance.now() receipt time. Gate held input against the conservative server timestamp plus elapsed receipt time, rounded up to the integer server deadline; retain monotonic visual interpolation and source movement durations.

diagnostics.cause: An in-flight directional packet after autonomous wild admission encountered a missing world runtime and triggered RECONNECT_REQUIRED, disconnecting the newly opened battle.
diagnostics.correction: Ignore that packet only after validating current authentication, lease, connection/map generations, active wild battle and its saved origin. Failed asynchronous fences freeze publication.

diagnostics.cause: The first focused run passed ten scenarios but exhausted the existing signup rate limit while creating fixtures for the fourth cadence mode (HTTP 429).
diagnostics.correction: Restart the test-owned backend before the four cadence fixtures. Production rate limits and application behavior are unchanged.

limitations: Movement timing evidence is a short local Chromium sample with walking/running and encounters off/on; remote latency was not benchmarked.
Existing source battle engines were verified but not extended or rebuilt in this bug-fix pass.
All mutating automated checks used isolated _test fixtures. Main ADMINA and ADMINB were not logged into or reset.
